title: Errors
description:
A query that fails now and then, backing off, and a source that sends a bad item now and
then. The last good result stays on screen with the error above it. See
`:help dbdash-errors`.

show.title: Fails 3 times in 6, backing off
show.description:
Refreshes 3, 4 and 5 of every six fail: the error shows above the last good result
and the next tries wait 2 and then 4 intervals.

query.sql:
for i = 1, 600 do
  if i % 5 == 0 then
    print("not json " .. i)     -- this item fails; the next ones go on
  else
    print(vim.json.encode({ { item = i, at = os.date("%H:%M:%S") } }))
  end
  dbdash.sleep(1000)
end

show.title: Every fifth item is bad
show.description:
Without `query.transform` an item must be JSON rows: every fifth one is not, so it
fails on its own and the source goes on.
